prompt: We have 2.7 billion UUID points across 6 instances. Everything is configured to be on disk, vectors, payloads, HNSW. But each instance is still using 20 GB of RAM. Our calculation says ID tracker should only be ~7-8 GB (460M points x 16 bytes). Why is memory so high, and will it double if we increase replication factor to 2?

assertions.text: Identifies this as Phase 3B unexpectedly high memory
Lists RAM consumers beyond ID tracker: HNSW graph, payload indexes, collection overhead, segment overhead, OS page cache
Correctly states RF=2 doubles data memory but not OS page cache
Warns about stream_records OOM risk during resharding for large shards
Recommends checking telemetry to separate data from cache before concluding
Recommends escalating to support if config doesn't explain the gap
